title: Smuggling of SAF Uniforms through Batam
what_it_is: Smuggling of SAF Uniforms through Batam

sections.label: SAF used uniform disposal procedures
sections.summary: SAF servicemen can dispose of used uniforms at SAF eMarts, where contractors incinerate them under SAF witness, and SAF will add more bins and collection points.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: SAF Servicemen who need to dispose of their used uniforms can do so via collection points at all SAF eMarts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Our contractors for uniform disposal collect the used uniforms and send them to the incinerators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The used uniforms are then incinerated under witness by an SAF personnel.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Following the incident, SAF has reminded our contractors to ensure that all uniform disposals are done in accordance with established procedures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: SAF will also be putting up more disposal bins at SAF eMarts and will establish used uniform collection points at entrances of selected camps near populated areas in the next two to three months to reinforce the system.

sections.label: Contractors followed uniform disposal procedures
sections.summary: Investigations found authorised contractors disposed of uniforms per procedures, and SAF will add disposal bins with one-way non-return valves at selected camp entrances.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Our investigations have found that our authorised contractors have disposed of uniforms in accordance with established procedures.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: To enhance the convenience of our Servicemen, SAF will be putting the disposal bins with a one-way non-return valve at the entrance of selected camps near populated areas.

sections.label: Indonesian Navy uniform investigation
sections.summary: Media reported the Indonesian Navy is investigating, and Singapore is waiting for the outcome and will work with them if needed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: It was reported by the media that the Indonesian Navy is investigating.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We are waiting for the outcome of their investigation and, should there be any need for us to work together with them, we will certainly work with them.
